scenes.text: My name is Leo, and I'm a monster hunter.
I keep my city safe, even when things get a little scary.
It's worth it, because I'm protecting all my friends.
This morning, I was on my way to the Drury Lane Bakery to buy my favorite muffin when ...
the bakery door suddenly burst open and Ms. Butterbuns tumbled out.

scenes.question: What was the child covered in?
scenes.successAnswer: The child is covered in cookie or the child is a cookie.
scenes.hint: Ask what does the taste remind you of?

flow.text: I run as fast as I can, chasing the cookie thief.
That's where the cookie went! The child covered himself!
As I get closer, I can see the thief is indeed covered in a thick brown mud.
At one point I get so close I can almost grab him!
But I slip and fall right on my face!
He runs off again, and now my hand is covered in this brown mud.
I lick the brown substance, and it doesn't taste like mud at all. It tastes like cinnamon and white frosting.
That child isn't covered in mud at all. He's covered in...
